trigger: Plays immediately after defeating BEIGE™ in the grand finale.

lines.speaker: beige
lines.text: System error... Aesthetic standard lost... Restoring... saturation...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 8:59 AM. With sixty seconds to spare, Ashwath commits the Final Cut to main.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Production deployed! Zero merge conflicts! The film is live worldwide!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Across Neo-Amritsar, vibrant neon cyan, hot pink, and gold flood through the streets.

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: Color has returned! The chai stalls are glowing again!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, cutting chai for the whole city! Chacha, put it on my tab. Le re!

lines.speaker: chad-frictionless
lines.text: My turtlenecks! They're turning tie-dye! This violates our seed agreement!

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: And that, Chad, is a wrap. Print it. Picture wrap on the universe.
